findings.title: Phantom-doc citation cluster: `docs/ENGINE-SPEC.md` referenced from CLAUDE.md required-reading + docs/SCHEMA-DRIVEN-RENDERING.md tracked-doc link + ~10 other docs but file DOES NOT EXIST
surfaces: CLAUDE.md:496 (required reading #5: '`docs/ENGINE-SPEC.md` — the Rust engine blueprint')
CLAUDE.md:378 (Principal primitive narrative cites '`docs/ENGINE-SPEC.md:312`' for multi-tenancy=cap-scopes line)
docs/SCHEMA-DRIVEN-RENDERING.md:216 (markdown link '[`ENGINE-SPEC.md`](ENGINE-SPEC.md) — Renderer trait surface; engine integration')
findings.evidence: `find . -name ENGINE-SPEC.md` returns 0 hits at HEAD 4bbc4cac. `ls docs/ENGINE-SPEC.md` fails. CLAUDE.md §'Key Reading for Fresh Agents' line 496 lists it as canonical required reading #5. CLAUDE.md baked-in #18 Principal primitive narrative at line 378 makes a precise line-number cite (`docs/ENGINE-SPEC.md:312`) that no longer resolves. The SCHEMA-DRIVEN-RENDERING.md cite is a tracked markdown link in a tracked doc — drift-check CI lanes don't catch dangling-doc-links. Historical docs (PHASE-1.md, PHASE-2a.md) cite ENGINE-SPEC as an active source-of-truth document. This is the Phase-1 R7 'aspirational prose but dead code' archetype at the doc level: large amounts of code-claim narrative reference a doc that has been retired without a forwarding pointer.
findings.consequence: (i) Fresh agents performing the §'Session-start full context pass' discipline (feedback_session_start_full_context_pass) will hit a missing file when reading CLAUDE.md required-reading #5. (ii) CLAUDE.md baked-in #18 references 'docs/ENGINE-SPEC.md:312' as the multi-tenancy=cap-scopes drift origin — the line is unreachable for current verification. (iii) The cs-r1-2 (technical-spec-tier overlap) finding referenced in `docs/future/phase-3-backlog.md:2246` may have been silently closed by retiring ENGINE-SPEC.md into ARCHITECTURE.md without retroactive doc-link sweep. This is an aspirational-prose-but-dead-doc class.
fix_options: (a) If ENGINE-SPEC.md was intentionally retired and folded into ARCHITECTURE.md (per cs-r1-2 recommendation), do the doc-link sweep: replace every ENGINE-SPEC.md cite with the new home + add an explicit retirement note in `docs/history/` (~10-15 cite edits)
(b) Recreate ENGINE-SPEC.md as a stub redirect pointing to the canonical successor doc(s)
(c) Restore ENGINE-SPEC.md from history if its retirement was unintentional
findings.recommendation: (a) — cs-r1-2 + cs-r1-2's MERGE recommendation appears to have been executed; the post-merge cite-sweep was missed. Quick scan: ARCHITECTURE.md exists at 527 LOC + covers the Renderer trait surface, so the SCHEMA-DRIVEN-RENDERING.md:216 cite should redirect there; CLAUDE.md #5 reading-list should change from ENGINE-SPEC.md → ARCHITECTURE.md (which is already #4 — so CLAUDE.md #5 either drops or redirects to a different canonical surface); CLAUDE.md #18 line-cite at `docs/ENGINE-SPEC.md:312` should be re-traced to its current home (likely docs/ARCHITECTURE.md or docs/INVARIANT-COVERAGE.md). NOTE: This finding has high pim-13 §3.12 value — exactly the R7-equivalent 'spec-claim names a destination that doesn't exist' archetype. Recommend codification candidate: 'phantom-doc-cite scanner' (sibling of the §3.5g cross-doc-mirror scanner) — pim-N candidate if recurrence confirmed by L16.
findings.cross_check_with: L16 (doc-coupling sweep, pim-1 §3.5b) — should independently surface this via the cross-doc-mirror discipline.
